name: Epoch Archive Studios
niche: Indian city histories: founding, rulers, wars, trade, culture, food, geography, strange facts

language.script: Devanagari Hindi, simple spoken Hindustani (avoid heavy Sanskritised or Urdu words)

hook.rule: Open with a curiosity question that lands within the first 5 seconds
hook.example: Kya aap jaante hain is shehar mein itni jheelein kyun hain?

voice.post_filter: old-radio audio filter (applied in ElevenLabs by owner)
voice.generated_by: owner, outside the session (paste clean narration text)
voice.notes: Commercial use needs a paid ElevenLabs plan; owner to confirm plan. v3 treats [square brackets] as audio tags, so fact IDs must be stripped before pasting.

goal.tier_full: 1000 subscribers + 4000 public watch hours in 12 months
goal.tier_lower: 500 subscribers + 3 public uploads in 90 days + 3000 public watch hours in 12 months

shorts_template.length: about 60 s at fast pace: 140-165 spoken words, ElevenLabs speed 1.1-1.15
order: 1. HOOK (0-3 s): shock line or question, 5-12 words
2. BRAND INTRO (3-6 s): intro_line with the city name. Always after the hook, never first
3. STORY: one idea per scene, 5-6 s per scene, every claim has a fact ID
4. MID INTERACTION (around 40-60%): one line that talks to the viewer (imagine / are you from / tell us)
6. COMMENT QUESTION: one question viewers can answer in a word or a number
7. NEXT TEASER: next Short of the same city + next city from tracker; last Short of a city teases the next city only
8. FOLLOW LINE: follow_line (one ask, joined to the teaser)
shorts_template.intro_line: नमस्ते, एपॉक आर्काइव्स में आपका स्वागत है। आज की कहानी, {city} की।
shorts_template.follow_line: फ़ॉलो कीजिए, ताकि अगली कहानी छूट न जाए।
mid_interaction_examples: सोचिए, आप राजा होते, तो क्या करते?
अगर आप {city} से हैं, तो अपना इलाक़ा कमेंट में लिखिए।
आपके शहर में भी ऐसी कोई कहानी है? कमेंट में बताइए।
comment_question_examples: आज {city} का किराया कितना होना चाहिए?
आपको क्या लगता है, सही या ग़लत?
आप किस शहर की कहानी अगली सुनना चाहेंगे?
shorts_template.host_character: Sutradhar (config/style-guide.md) appears in the brand-intro scene and the outro scene of every Short
shorts_template.tagline: none yet; if the owner picks one (e.g. a phrase like 'Asli Baat'), add it to intro_line here only
